description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains related to deadlock scenarios, including non-reentrant and reentrant grains, as well as a call chain provider for testing reentrancy behavior.

classes.name: DeadlockGrain
classes.description: Contains static method for recursively calling grains, used to set up deadlock scenarios.

classes.name: DeadlockNonReentrantGrain
classes.description: A grain implementation that demonstrates non-reentrant behavior with methods invoking other grains.

classes.name: DeadlockReentrantGrain
classes.description: A grain marked as [Reentrant], allowing reentrant calls, with methods similar to DeadlockNonReentrantGrain.

classes.name: CallChainReentrancyGrain
classes.description: A grain facilitating chained calls with different reentrancy behaviors, used for testing reentrancy scenarios.

methods.name: CallNext
methods.description: A static method to recursively invoke the next grain in a call chain, handling blocking and non-blocking grains.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Method in grains to continue the call chain, logging invocation and invoking next call.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Method in grains to continue the call chain, similar to CallNext_1.

methods.name: CallChain
methods.description: Starts a chain of calls among grains with specified reentrancy behaviors, observing reentrancy rules.

methods.name: UnblockWaiters
methods.description: Resets the internal unblocker task, allowing waiters to proceed.
